value.rationale: The physical motivation is a memory-bearing bath that is never reset, while the probe is increasingly often reset. Prior one-time results suggest effectively bath-independent rapid-reset probe positions, but that does not determine time correlations. The derived fixed-lag residual and fixed-frequency Lorentzian provide quantitative bath-memory observables, an exact integrated-correlation enhancement r*tau -> 1+g/2, and a measurable crossover lag log(2r)/r. This is a natural two-time diagnostic of persistent environmental memory rather than a routine renaming of the one-time variance.
